job.name: filesizecheck
job.script:
#!/bin/bash
echo "Scanning for oversized files..."
# Validate REPO_ROOT exists and is a directory if [ ! -d "$REPO_ROOT" ]; then echo "ERROR: REPO_ROOT is not a valid directory" exit 1 fi
# Use absolute path for REPO_ROOT REPO_ROOT=$(realpath "$REPO_ROOT") echo "Starting file size analysis in $REPO_ROOT"
# Create temporary files for results RESULTS_FILE=$(mktemp) OVERSIZED_COUNT_FILE=$(mktemp) echo "0" | tee "$OVERSIZED_COUNT_FILE" # Initialize counter file
# Size limits in bytes CODE_SIZE_LIMIT=102400 # 100KB IMAGE_SIZE_LIMIT=2097152 # 2MB BINARY_SIZE_LIMIT=1048576 # 1MB REPO_SIZE_LIMIT=5242880 # 5MB
# Calculate total repository size REPO_SIZE=$(du -sb "$REPO_ROOT" | awk '{print $1}') echo "Total repository size: $(du -sh "$REPO_ROOT" | awk '{print $1}')" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE"
if [ "$REPO_SIZE" -gt "$REPO_SIZE_LIMIT" ]; then echo "WARNING: Repository exceeds recommended size limit of $(echo $REPO_SIZE_LIMIT | awk '{ printf "%.2f MB", $1/1024/1024 }')" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" echo "1" | tee "$OVERSIZED_COUNT_FILE" fi
# Check for oversized files using find's built-in size filter echo "Checking for oversized files..." | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" find "$REPO_ROOT" -type f -not -path "*/\.*" -not -path "*/\.git/*" -size +100k -ls > "$RESULTS_FILE"
echo "FOUND OVERSIZED FILES:" # Display the results cat "$RESULTS_FILE"
# Count how many large files were found OVERSIZED_FILES=$(grep -c "" "$RESULTS_FILE" || echo "0")
# Check results if [ "$OVERSIZED_FILES" -gt 0 ]; then echo "FILE SIZE ERROR: Found $OVERSIZED_FILES oversized files" echo "Please reduce the size of these files or remove them from the repository." echo "Maximum recommended sizes:" echo "- Code files: $(echo $CODE_SIZE_LIMIT | awk '{ printf "%.2f KB", $1/1024 }')" echo "- Images: $(echo $IMAGE_SIZE_LIMIT | awk '{ printf "%.2f MB", $1/1024/1024 }')" echo "- Binary files: $(echo $BINARY_SIZE_LIMIT | awk '{ printf "%.2f MB", $1/1024/1024 }')" echo "- Total repository: $(echo $REPO_SIZE_LIMIT | awk '{ printf "%.2f MB", $1/1024/1024 }')" echo "reject" | tee /pr-status/status exit 1 else echo 'File size check passed for {%= app_name %}' echo "All files are within reasonable size limits" fi
# Clean up rm -f "$RESULTS_FILE" "$OVERSIZED_COUNT_FILE"
